title: Morando Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Morando architecture analysis tool

includes.description: Array of glob patterns for files to include in analysis

ignores.description: Array of glob patterns for files to exclude from analysis

layers.description: Ordered list of layer names, from highest to lowest abstraction level

layerMatchers.description: Array of rules to match files to specific layers

layer.description: The layer name this matcher assigns to matching files

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against
